# MarketLab

> MarketLab is a local-first charting and quantitative research terminal that runs entirely in the browser. Users import or download OHLCV data, then chart it with candlesticks and indicators, screen it with rule-based filters, and backtest long-only strategies. All data stays on the user's own device; the app makes no third-party network requests unless the user opts into the optional local download service.

## What it does

- Interactive charts: candlestick, bar, line, and area series; volume pane; linear, log, and percentage price scales; crosshair readout legend.
- Indicators computed from first principles: SMA, EMA, Bollinger Bands, RSI, MACD, Stochastic, ATR, ADX, Anchored VWAP, Volume SMA / relative volume, On-Balance Volume, Ichimoku Cloud.
- Drawing tools: trend line, ray, horizontal and vertical levels, zone rectangle, Fibonacci retracement, measure move, text labels; drag-to-move, undo/redo, delete.
- Multi-panel layouts: single, two stacked, two side by side, four panels, with link groups for symbol, timeframe, and visible range. Reducing a layout hides panels without deleting them.
- Quant lab: annualised return and volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, maximum drawdown, Calmar, historical VaR/CVaR, beta, correlation matrix, and a normalised performance comparison chart.
- Screener: field/operator/value rules evaluated over historical sessions at a chosen cutoff date, with per-row filter columns and saved screens.
- Backtesting: a long-only rule engine with explicit execution assumptions (signals evaluated at close, fills at the next session's open, costs and slippage, no shorting), an equity curve against buy-and-hold, and a trade log.
- Workspaces, watchlists, preferences: per-chart configuration, saved watchlists, persisted theme and layout preferences.
- Export and backup: dataset/quant/screener/backtest CSV exports plus a versioned JSON workspace backup that can be merged or restored.
- Command palette (`Ctrl`/`Cmd`+`K`): filter navigation, run import/download/backup actions, and search the datasets already stored in the local library.
- Field guide at `/#/learn`: the conventions behind stored bars, returns, risk, comparison, screening and backtest execution, with a metric reference, calculators and rule-check cases.

## Data and honesty

- MarketLab ships no bundled or sample market data. The library starts empty; data comes from CSV import or the optional local provider service.
- CSV import validates every series: prices must be positive, `low <= min(open, close) <= max(open, close) <= high`, sessions must be unique under an explicit duplicate policy, and missing sessions are reported as gaps, never invented.
- Daily data is never interpolated into intraday bars. Only daily-to-weekly (Monday-based) and daily-to-monthly aggregation is offered, and aggregated series are labelled as such.
- Backtest results are presented together with the execution model that produced them.
- Optional real historical data: run the bundled Python service (FastAPI + yfinance, no API key) and download daily bars from Yahoo Finance via Data > Download market data. Such data is unofficial, may be delayed, and is not licensed for redistribution; every downloaded series carries its provider, exchange, adjustment policy, and retrieval timestamp.

## Optional local market-data service

MarketLab ships an optional, local-only service that downloads daily historical bars from Yahoo Finance without an API key. It binds to 127.0.0.1 only, requires no keys or secrets, and is not deployed anywhere; it runs on the user's own machine. Without it, the app works fully from CSV imports and datasets you have already downloaded.

## Using MarketLab with an AI agent

- The app is a single-page application; all routes are hash routes under `/#/` (for example `/#/chart`, `/#/screener`, `/#/backtest`, `/#/quant`, `/#/data`, `/#/learn`, `/#/workspaces`). An agent driving a browser can navigate directly to those URLs.
- All analysis is deterministic and reproducible from the stored series: the same dataset, indicator parameters, filters, or strategy always produce the same numbers.
- Nothing in the app requires an account, a network connection, or any credential. There is nothing to purchase and no checkout.
